label: The relative risk: the risk of the outcome in the exposed group divided by the risk of the outcome in the unexposed group
The crude relative risk: the pooled risk in all exposed divided by the pooled risk in all unexposed, ignoring strata

The Mantel-Haenszel relative risk: the sum over strata of exposed cases times unexposed total divided by stratum total, divided by the sum over strata of exposed total times unexposed cases divided by stratum total
The confounder criteria: a confounder is associated with the exposure, is a cause of the outcome independent of the exposure, and is not on the causal path between exposure and outcome
tex: C\not\perp E\;;\quad C\rightarrow Y\ \text{independently of }E\;;\quad E\nrightarrow C\rightarrow Y

label: The lab model: the risk in the exposed equals smoking prevalence among exposed times baseline risk times smoking effect plus one minus that prevalence times baseline risk, and symmetrically for the unexposed
